metadata.description: In this exclusive interview, we sit down with Dr. Velaram Ghogra, the President of the Bhartiya Tribal Party (BTP) in Rajasthan, to discuss the party's journey over the past five years and its prospects in the upcoming state elections. The BTP made headlines in the 2018 assembly elections by securing two seats and leaving a significant impact on other constituencies reserved for Scheduled Tribes. However, the party's fortunes have fluctuated since then. Dr. Ghogara sheds light on the reasons behind the party's successes and setbacks, its achievements during its time in power, and its strategies for the approaching election. With a deep understanding of tribal issues and grassroots politics, Dr. Ghogara provides insights into how the BTP aims to recapture its earlier success and make a lasting impact on Rajasthan's political landscape. This interview offers a comprehensive overview of the Bhartiya Tribal Party's journey and its aspirations for the future.
